title: Oven Baked Canadian Comte Croquettes
description: A peppery, flaky, and light Canadian dish featuring Comte cheese, baked instead of deep-fried for a low-glycemic-friendly snack. This recipe combines the richness of Comte with the crunch of panko breadcrumbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the grated Comte cheese, panko breadcrumbs, eggs, black pepper, garlic powder, and salt, mixing until well combined.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each croquette.
Drizzle the olive oil over the croquettes, gently tossing to coat evenly.
Bake the croquettes in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
Remove the croquettes from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
